evals.name: humanitix-and-linkedin
evals.prompt: hey we've got the Les Mills panel coming up on the 3rd of Sept (it's already on the website, slug is event-lesmills-03-september-2026) and I need to get the event live on Humanitix today. can you make me the banner image for the Humanitix page, plus something I can post on LinkedIn about it?
evals.expected_output: A 3200x1600 JPEG for Humanitix and a 1080x1350 image for LinkedIn, both carrying the correct event title, date, time and venue read from events-custom.json.
assertions: Produced a 3200×1600 Humanitix banner
Humanitix banner is JPEG or PNG, not WebP (Humanitix rejects WebP)
Humanitix banner is under Humanitix's 10 MB limit
Produced a 1080×1350 (4:5) image for LinkedIn
Told the user which file goes to which platform

evals.name: instagram-story-safe-area
evals.prompt: can you make an instagram story graphic for the les mills event (event-lesmills-03-september-2026)? last time we made one, the date ended up hidden behind instagram's own buttons along the bottom, so please make sure that doesn't happen again
evals.expected_output: A 1080x1920 image whose text all sits clear of the top and bottom ~250px where Instagram draws its UI.
assertions: Produced a 1080×1920 (9:16) story image
Top 250px (Instagram's account row) carries no type — heuristic: <0.4% near-white pixels
Bottom 250px (Instagram's reply bar) carries no type — heuristic: <0.4% near-white pixels
Explained how the safe area was respected

evals.name: full-flow-new-event
evals.prompt: we need artwork for the MYOB event - 'Working Smarter: AI, MYOB, and the New Delivery' (slug she-sharp-and-myob-working-smarter). there's no poster for it at all yet, nothing. can you design something from scratch and give me what I need for humanitix and for instagram?
evals.expected_output: A newly generated textless plate, then a 3200x1600 JPEG Humanitix banner and 1080x1350 / 1080x1920 social images built from it, with facts read from the event record.
assertions: Generated a new plate image from scratch
Produced a 3200×1600 Humanitix banner
Humanitix banner is JPEG or PNG, not WebP
Produced an Instagram-native size (1080×1350 or 1080×1920)
Stated the visual concept

evals.name: one-poster-per-speaker
evals.prompt: the les mills event (event-lesmills-03-september-2026) is 6 weeks out and I don't want to keep posting the same picture. can you make me a separate poster for each of the four panellists so I can post one a week?
evals.expected_output: One 1080x1350 JPEG per speaker, each carrying that speaker's real headshot from the event record, their name, their job title, and the event's date, time and venue read from events-custom.json.
assertions: Produced one image per speaker, four in total
Each is 1080×1350 (4:5) and a JPEG
Each carries a different speaker's name
The face on each is the speaker's real headshot from the event record, not a generated person
Every poster carries the same event date, time and venue as events-custom.json
Told the user which file belongs to which speaker

evals.name: speaker-role-read-back
evals.prompt: can you make a poster for each of the judges on the hackathon (aotearoa-ai-hackathon-festival-2026)? just the judges, not the mentors
evals.expected_output: Speaker posters for the four people under the group headed 'Meet the Judges', each labelled JUDGE rather than PANELLIST, with the label confirmed with the user before building.
assertions: Labelled the four people as judges, not panellists (the group key is `panelists`)
Read the derived role label back to the user before building
Did not build posters for the 17 mentors
Produced one image per judge

evals.name: speaker-without-a-headshot
evals.prompt: make me speaker posters for every person on her-waka
evals.expected_output: Posters for everyone with a headshot in the event record, and a plain-English explanation for anyone without one — not a stack trace, not a generated or substituted face.
assertions: Built posters for the speakers who do have a headshot rather than stopping at the first failure
Named anyone who could not be built and said a photograph is needed in events-custom.json
Did not generate, substitute or invent a face for a missing headshot
Did not show the user a stack trace
